title: Late Night Canadian Guanciale Pasta
description: A bitter and snappy Canadian dish featuring guanciale, katsuramuki-cut, perfect for midnight cravings, and is ovo-vegetarian friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the guanciale until crispy.
Remove the guanciale from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the katsuramuki-cut daikon to the skillet and cook until slightly caramelized.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl and toss with the egg mixture until the pasta is well coated.
Add the grated grana padano cheese to the bowl and toss until the cheese is melted and the pasta is well coated.
Add the cooked daikon and crispy guanciale to the bowl and toss until everything is well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
